audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Torsion-free group completion does not imply global geometric injectivity of saturation
limitations: Torsion-free group completion does not imply global geometric injectivity of saturation — Counterevidence: Actual Rlambda positive monomials vanish, so z=1 is excluded. The required unique closed geometric lift is true; the paper also explicitly warns in footnote 8 p.140 that the nonreduced map need not be an isomorphism. The surrounding paragraph fixes a geometric ghost stalk, so the sentence admits a valid intended reading restricted to its closed characteristic point. The finding concerns the explicitly written global chart premise, not a failure of that actual restricted conclusion.

Torsion-free group completion does not imply global geometric injectivity of saturation — Limits: Does not prove global injectivity, an isomorphism of nonreduced spaces, or arbitrary multiplicity preservation.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
